description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomLegoMachine"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/custom-lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomLegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CustomLegoMachine">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Building</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSetsToChildren</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RedesignSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MachineAssembled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Begin building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" name="Give sets to the children"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge" name="Continue component work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable" name="Parts available in a container?" default="Flow_PartsUnavailable"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build a subcomponent using sorted parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test the subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestSuccessful" name="Test successful?" default="Flow_TestFailed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign the subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" name="More subcomponents to build?" default="Flow_NoMoreSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Order" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Give" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Give_Sort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sort_PrepareMerge" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareMerge_Available" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable" name="Parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">parts remain in a container</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsUnavailable" name="Container is empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_PrepareMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Decision" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestPassed" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful" targetRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">subcomponent test is successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed" name="Not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesign_PrepareMerge" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreSubcomponents" name="More remain" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareParts_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">more subcomponents remain to be built</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoMoreSubcomponents" name="All tested successfully" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
